comparisons.note: ABBA uses the mean of two process medians per source. Separation is descriptive, not a significance test. Actual binding ratios use separate single-process measurements.

diagnostics.note: Untimed source-paired reports verify resolution-disabled control equality and full values/metadata/cost/error prefixes. Matching binding/state cases have identical current physical plans and EXPLAIN across sources and runtimes; different bindings may choose different plans. New LEFT entries retain bounded resolution, never physical templates; all observed non-NULL matching outer cases still invoke the base planner. Column/source metadata share one independently recounted allowance. Weak-reference observations follow completed-thread exit and GC and are reported verbatim.

cross.note: One fresh process per core; median of five samples. Cross-core checks rendered-value checksums/row counts, not exact costs/metadata. Existing collectors differ; exact binding verification is separate.

profiles.note: execute_prepared with the existing eager collector. All timings precede tracing. Allocations and call counts are diagnostic observations, not sampled CPU-time attribution.

harness_smoke.note: One successful untimed pre-pin fixture smoke, outside the 24 formal commands. Its raw outcome and supervisor report are preserved; no fixture or source correction was needed.
